clock-strokes.hears: The harp strikes twelve: twelve soft D4 strokes, one a bar (0.77 s apart), 0.19-8.81 s.
clock-strokes.rule: pack.notes D4 in 0-9.5 s, velocity >= 20 (drops a v18 ghost at 7.09 s; the roll splits stroke 2 into 0.85 + 0.96)

hush-chord.hears: The pp D major chord in the strings after the twelfth stroke (9.62 s), then near-silence to 15 s.

grave-pizz.hears: Seven low pizzicato notes, one a bar, D-A then up a diminished chord C-F#-A-C-Eb (13.61-18.09 s): the graves open. The first two are not in the roll.
grave-pizz.rule: audio D2 13.61 s and A2 14.33 s (onset_detect on the percussive part; CQT peak D2 then A2) + roll notes <= midi 52 in 15-18.5 s (both octaves of each)

tuning-tritone.hears: Death's fiddle: the solo violin's A-Eb tritone double stops (the E string tuned down to Eb), 18.88-25.69 s, quickening.
tuning-tritone.rule: roll violin/viola/cello clusters 18.8-25.9 s that hold both A4 and Eb5; their A4 and Eb5

tuning-fifths.hears: The answering open D-A fifths of the solo violin between the tritones (19.88-25.37 s).
tuning-fifths.rule: roll violin/viola/cello clusters 19.8-25.9 s with D4 and A4 and no Eb5; their D4 and A4

dance-begins.hears: The two chords that start the dance: D (26.03 s) and the G minor downbeat (26.37 s), the first strong attacks of the piece.

pizz-waltz-bass.hears: The pizzicato waltz bass on the downbeats under the first themes (26.4-71.7 s): oom of oom-pah-pah.
pizz-waltz-bass.section: Theme A (flute) to theme A in D
pizz-waltz-bass.rule: bassline of roll notes <= midi 50, 26.3-71.7 s, nothing as low in the 0.3 s before

theme-a-flute.hears: The flute's waltz tune, theme A, G minor (26.4-41.3 s) - the roll barely has it: the YourMT3 flute rows (Pipe) and the roll's high strings notes that double it.
theme-a-flute.rule: ymt3 Pipe rows 26.4-41.3 s + roll skyline >= midi 70, minDur 0.1, 26.4-41.3 s

harp-chords-31.hears: The harp's soft F minor chords under the flute (30.9-32.5 s).

theme-b-solo-violin.hears: The solo violin's theme B, a sighing chromatic descent G-F-E-Eb-D, four phrases (41.6-55.5 s).
theme-b-solo-violin.rule: skyline of roll violin + voice notes midi 60-72, minDur 0.15, 41.3-55.6 s

theme-b-solo-p1.hears: Theme B, phrase 1 (G-F-E-Eb): one short Ivory row.

theme-b-solo-p2.hears: Theme B, phrase 2 (D-E-G-F#-E-D-E-F#): one short Ivory row.

theme-b-solo-p3.hears: Theme B, phrase 3 (G-F-Eb-D): one short Ivory row.

theme-b-solo-p4.hears: Theme B, phrase 4 (G-Bb-A-F#-D-F#-A-E-D): one short Ivory row.

theme-a-in-d.hears: Theme A again a fifth up, in D minor, over oboe/clarinet colour (55.1-68.5 s): the high strings' line.
theme-a-in-d.rule: skyline of roll string + oboe/clarinet notes >= midi 66, minDur 0.12, 55.1-68.5 s

winds-56.hears: Oboe and clarinet answers inside theme A in D (55.8-67 s).

build-to-tutti.hears: The swell into the first tutti: the violins climbing on Eb5/D5 (68.5-71.7 s).
build-to-tutti.rule: skyline of roll violin notes >= midi 62, minDur 0.1, 68.5-71.7 s

theme-a-tutti.hears: Theme A forte in the whole orchestra, the violins high (Bb5-Ab5-C6), 71.7-86.4 s.
theme-a-tutti.rule: skyline of roll violin + strings notes >= midi 70, minDur 0.1, 71.7-86.4 s

hammered-chords-80.hears: Repeated chords hammered in sixteenths, G minor then Ab major (79.9-83.9 s): bones rattling.
hammered-chords-80.rule: roll piano-track clusters 79.8-84 s; lowest and highest note

theme-b-tutti.hears: Theme B sung by the full strings, forte and legato, G-F-E-Eb-D (86.4-100.6 s): few audible attacks.
theme-b-tutti.rule: skyline of roll notes midi 62-71, minDur 0.25, 86.4-100.6 s

theme-b-tutti-p1.hears: Theme B tutti, phrase 1 (G-F-E-(G)-D-Eb-D): one short Ivory row.

theme-b-tutti-p2.hears: Theme B tutti, phrase 2 (D-E-G-F#-E-D-E-F#-A-D): one short Ivory row.

theme-b-tutti-p3.hears: Theme B tutti, phrase 3 (F held, then G-Bb-A-F#-D-F#-E): one short Ivory row.

theme-a-xylophone-d.hears: Theme A in D minor with the xylophone (100.7-115 s): the violins' high line.
theme-a-xylophone-d.section: Theme A in D with xylophone
theme-a-xylophone-d.rule: skyline of roll violin notes >= midi 74, minDur 0.1, 100.7-115 s

xylophone-bones.hears: The xylophone: dry rattling bones (104.7-106.2 s, 111.8-114.6 s, 233.5-239.1 s). Not in any track: YourMT3 labelled it Chromatic Percussion.

repeated-d-chords.hears: Repeated D major chords pulsing under the xylophone (102.7-111.2 s).
repeated-d-chords.section: Theme A in D with xylophone
repeated-d-chords.rule: roll piano-track clusters 102.5-111.4 s; lowest and highest note

exposition-close.hears: The D-A tremolo and the octave D blow that close the first part (115.5-119.5 s).
exposition-close.rule: pack clusters 115.4-119.6 s with a note >= 100 or >= 4 notes; lowest and highest

bass-tutti-1.hears: The bass under the first tutti (71.7-120.4 s), one note a beat.
bass-tutti-1.section: Theme A tutti to the close
bass-tutti-1.rule: bassline of roll notes <= midi 50, 71.7-120.4 s, gap 0.3 s

fugato-subject-low.hears: The fugato's subject entering low in the cellos and basses (120.5 s on), then its countersubjects (120.4-149.5 s).
fugato-subject-low.rule: skyline of roll cello + strings notes <= midi 57, minDur 0.12, 120.4-149.5 s

fugato-high.hears: The upper fugato voices (violins), entering one after the other and climbing to the brass (120.4-149.5 s).
fugato-high.rule: skyline of roll violin + viola notes >= midi 55, minDur 0.12, 120.4-149.5 s

brass-calls.hears: Every brass entry: the fugato peak (145.5-149 s), the A pedal climax (170-176 s), the ff of 228-231 s, 340-344 s and the last hammer (374.9-376.8 s).

pedal-e-toll.hears: The low E2 struck again and again under the theme fragments (149.6-162.3 s): a toll.
pedal-e-toll.rule: roll cello notes E2 (40) and E3 (52) 149.5-162.4 s, bassline gap 0.2

pedal-a-toll.hears: The low A2 pedal that replaces it, crescendo to 175.4 s (162.4-175.4 s).
pedal-a-toll.rule: roll notes A1/A2/Ab1/Ab2 (33, 45, 32, 44) 162.4-175.4 s, bassline gap 0.2

pedal-line-high.hears: The violins' line over the pedals (theme fragments in E and A), 149.5-175.4 s.
pedal-line-high.rule: skyline of roll violin notes >= midi 64, minDur 0.15, 149.5-175.4 s

winds-156.hears: The oboe, clarinet and bassoon voices inside the E pedal passage (155.8-158 s).
winds-156.rule: roll oboe + clarinet + bassoon notes 150-162 s

chorale-top.hears: The slow legato chorale in B major (175.4-213 s), the passage the research calls the mocking Dies irae chorale: its long top notes fall chromatically B-Bb-A-G like theme B, while its chroma is closest to theme A in B (match 0.45-0.55; theme B only 0.36). The audio has almost no onsets here.
chorale-top.rule: skyline of roll notes >= midi 60 lasting >= 0.6 s, not plucked, 175.4-213 s

chorale-p1.hears: Chorale phrase 1 (the four phrases repeat every ~8.4 s: chroma self-match 0.73, 0.59, 0.47): one short Ivory row or one handover.

chorale-p2.hears: Chorale phrase 2 (the four phrases repeat every ~8.4 s: chroma self-match 0.73, 0.59, 0.47): one short Ivory row or one handover.

chorale-p3.hears: Chorale phrase 3 (the four phrases repeat every ~8.4 s: chroma self-match 0.73, 0.59, 0.47): one short Ivory row or one handover.

chorale-p4.hears: Chorale phrase 4 (the four phrases repeat every ~8.4 s: chroma self-match 0.73, 0.59, 0.47): one short Ivory row or one handover.

chorale-bass.hears: The chorale's slow bass notes (175.4-213 s).
chorale-bass.rule: bassline of roll notes <= midi 52 lasting >= 0.5 s, gap 1.0 s, 175.4-213 s

harp-arpeggios.hears: The harp's rippling arpeggios around the chorale (176-209 s).
harp-arpeggios.rule: roll plucked track 175-210 s + ymt3 Orchestral Harp rows 178-209 s

chorale-pulse.hears: The repeated B/F# figures that keep a faint pulse under the chorale (199.3-208.9 s).

build-213.hears: The crescendo out of the chorale: tremolo Eb6 above, A/Ab octaves hammered low (213-222 s).
build-213.rule: roll piano-track clusters 213-222 s; lowest and highest note

tutti-c-line.hears: The ff tutti that opens at 222 s: the violins' line (222-244.5 s).
tutti-c-line.rule: skyline of roll violin + strings notes >= midi 67, minDur 0.15, 222-244.5 s

bass-tutti-2.hears: The bass of the second tutti (213-244.5 s).
bass-tutti-2.rule: bassline of roll notes <= midi 50, 213-244.5 s, gap 0.3 s

stop-244.hears: The tutti breaks off: the chords of 244.1 and 246.0 s.
stop-244.rule: pack clusters 244-246.5 s with >= 3 notes and a note >= 95

winds-interlude.hears: The bassoons, clarinets and oboe alone in the quiet (245-272.5 s): theme fragments passed from voice to voice.
winds-interlude.rule: roll oboe + clarinet + bassoon notes 245-272.5 s

interlude-strings.hears: The soft string notes under the woodwinds (248-272 s).
interlude-strings.rule: skyline of roll violin/viola/cello notes, minDur 0.3, 248-272 s

cascade-262.hears: A quick cascade tumbling down from G5 (261.7-264.6 s).
cascade-262.rule: top note of each roll cluster 261.6-264.7 s, notes >= midi 55

bass-development.hears: The D pedal and the bass of the long build (272.5-322.8 s).
bass-development.rule: bassline of roll notes <= midi 50, 272.5-322.8 s, gap 0.3 s

development-line.hears: The violins over the D pedal: theme A fragments in D (272.5-297 s).
development-line.rule: skyline of roll violin notes >= midi 62, minDur 0.2, 272.5-297 s

build-line.hears: Theme A in D, forte, rising to ff (297-320.4 s): the violins' top line.
build-line.rule: skyline of roll violin notes >= midi 66, minDur 0.15, 297-320.4 s

repeated-d-303.hears: Repeated D major chords in sixteenths (303.2-305.0 s).
repeated-d-303.rule: roll piano-track clusters 303-305.1 s; lowest and highest

chromatic-ascent.hears: The rising chromatic scale that launches the recapitulation (320.6-322.8 s).
chromatic-ascent.rule: top note of roll clusters 320.4-322.9 s; only notes higher than the one before

recap-theme-b-line.hears: The ff recapitulation, where theme B's harmony returns (chroma match 0.65 and 0.61 with the solo statement at 324.0 and 331.0 s): the strings' held notes, middle-high. The roll does not hold the tune cleanly (322.8-338 s).
recap-theme-b-line.rule: skyline of roll notes midi 64-79 minDur 0.25, not piano, 322.8-338 s

recap-high.hears: The violins' highest notes in the recapitulation (322.8-361 s).
recap-high.rule: skyline of roll violin notes >= midi 79, minDur 0.12, 322.8-361 s

recap-line.hears: The violin line through the second half of the recapitulation, themes A and B intertwined over the drums (338-360.8 s).
recap-line.rule: skyline of roll violin notes >= midi 62, minDur 0.15, 338-360.8 s

frenzy-line.hears: The top line of the frenzy before the hammering (360.8-370.7 s).
frenzy-line.rule: skyline of roll violin + strings notes >= midi 62, minDur 0.1, 360.8-370.7 s

bass-finale.hears: The bass of the recapitulation and the frenzy (322.8-376.8 s).
bass-finale.rule: bassline of roll notes <= midi 50, 322.8-376.8 s, gap 0.3 s

drum-strikes.hears: The bass drum and timpani strokes and rolls (330.6, 331.4, 336-337.2, 342.2-343.7, 364.7-366.6 s); also 151.7 and 158.4 s.

octave-hammer-g.hears: The F#-G octave hammering (370.73-371.43 s) and the G pedal blows over the A-Bb trill (372.73-374.16 s).
octave-hammer-g.rule: roll clusters 370.7-374.2 s with >= 4 notes, a string note on F# or G; lowest and highest

bass-trill.hears: The low A-Bb trill (with an Ab-G turn) in the basses under the final G pedal (372.73-374.71 s).

final-hammer.hears: The nine last blows of the dance: brass D4+G4, quickening and growing to 0 dB (374.89-376.80 s).

thread-high.hears: The voiced-out high line of the whole piece: held notes (>= 0.28 s) of violins, strings and winds above G4, top of their chord.
thread-high.rule: skyline of roll violin/strings/oboe/clarinet/voice notes >= midi 67, minDur 0.28, 0-430 s

thread-mid.hears: The middle voice of the whole piece (G3-C5): violas, second violins, the themes when they sit low (theme B).
thread-mid.rule: skyline of roll violin/viola notes midi 55-72, minDur 0.28, 0-430 s

thread-low.hears: The bass of the whole piece, at most one note per 0.5 s: pizzicato downbeats, pedals, tolls.
thread-low.rule: bassline of roll notes <= midi 50, gap 0.5 s, 0-430 s

long-notes.hears: Every long held note (>= 1.0 s), the top one of its chord: the slow notes where a handover is allowed.
long-notes.rule: skyline of roll notes lasting >= 1.0 s, 0-430 s (hold 1.5 s)

ff-blows.hears: The real fortissimo blows of the tutti: wide chords with the bass in them at the loudest moments (313.38, 336.26, 361.90, 364.44, 367.34, 371.21, 373.98 s), at most one per 2 s; the nine last blows are final-hammer.
ff-blows.rule: pack clusters with >= 3 notes, a note >= 103, loudness >= 0.86 and a note <= midi 55; the strongest of each 2 s; lowest and highest note

ff-blows-early.hears: The strongest blows of the first half: the dance's first downbeat (26.37), the octave D that ends the exposition (118.21), the tutti's C# stamp (237.78) and the break (244.08). Not ff by loudness (-5 to -12 dB): strikes, not Fireworks.
ff-blows-early.rule: pack clusters before 260 s with >= 2 notes and a note >= 103; one per 2 s; lowest and highest note

cock-crow.hears: A thin high woodwind call in the near-silence after the last blow: Eb5, Bb5, Eb5 and a held G5 (378.95-383.3 s) - the oboe's cock-crow. The roll has nothing here.
cock-crow.rule: audio: librosa onsets 378.95, 379.41, 379.88, 380.25 s; pitch from the CQT peak above C5; the G5 held to 383.3 s (pyin G5 380.68-382.83)

dawn-chords.hears: The pale chords of dawn: the sf chord on C#/G/Bb/Eb (383.66), the soft G major chords (389.65, 390.58), G-Bb-Eb (391.59) and G minor (394.02). Long, slow: handover allowed.

dawn-tremolo.hears: The measured tremolo F-Bb-Eb over C# (385.02-386.52 s), shivering, dying away.
dawn-tremolo.rule: roll plucked track 385-386.6 s, top note of each cluster

farewell-violin.hears: The solo violin's last wistful phrase, pianissimo: Bb-A-G, Bb-G-F-Eb, Eb-Ab-Bb-C-Eb (395.87-418 s); the dead slip away.
farewell-violin.rule: skyline of roll violin notes >= midi 55, 395.8-417.9 s (minDur 0.1); 411.58 A3 -> audio Bb3 411.68; + audio Eb4 413.32

last-trill.hears: The violin's D-Eb trill (418.0-420.0 s), shivering.

scurry.hears: The last scurry: pizzicato G minor figures and the violin's D-Eb flutter up to D6 (420.0-423.9 s).
scurry.rule: top note of roll clusters 420-424 s

final-pizz.hears: The bass falls Bb-G-D in pizzicato, then the last two chords, D major and G minor (424.07-426.24 s).
final-pizz.rule: roll clusters 424-426.5 s; lowest and highest note
